    The Boston Celtics vs. Minnesota Timberwolves game on Sunday, March 22, 2026, at 8 p.m. ET is broadcast on
    NBC and streamed on Peacock as part of Sunday Night Basketball. The game takes place at TD Garden in Boston. 
    • TV Channel: NBC
    • Live Stream: Peacock, Fubo TV (free trial)
    • Spanish Broadcast: Telemundo/Peacock 
    Alternative Streaming Options: 
    • NBC Sports Boston is often available for local viewers through live TV streaming services.
       
    Radio: 
    • 98.5 The Sports Hub (Boston)
    • Timberwolves App (Minnesota) 
    Note: Broadcast and streaming services can be subject to regional restrictions.
